column1: # Real routes: teleport items, reviewed against the WoW Forever client's own
# tables (pinned in tools/fixtures/travel/*-1.60.1.70862-enUS.csv by
# tools/pin_travel_client.py; see docs/data-audit.md "Teleport items and
# reagents"). The client has no destination for these spells (the landing is
# server-side), so each row ties the client's spell text to an existing
# network node. tools/build_travel.py checks that the client spell text names
# the landing, and takes cast time, cooldown, charges, slot, required skill,
# specialization and level from the client, never from this file.
# Columns: item, landing (node id, or town:<key> for that town's inn),
#   faction (only when the client text picks the landing by faction),
#   landing word that must appear in the client spell text,
#   outcome (misfire = the client text says it can go wrong; the step says so).
# Landings are estimated: the arrival point is the town, not a surveyed spot.
# Reviewed and left out (reasons in docs/data-audit.md): 260821 and 260823
# (Kaylaena's Workshop on Mount Hyjal: no network node, "high chance" of
# technical problems); 17690/17691/17900-17909/18149/18150 (Alterac Valley
# battleground recalls); 191267/191288 (inside Naxxramas); 241128 (random,
# New Avalon only); 213548 (to a party member); 22589/22630-22632, 12585,
# 17191 (group portals to dungeons/cities); 21711 (Lunar Festival only);
# 260830 (short-range Tinker teleport).
